Ciudad Universitaria — Madrid, Spain

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

The Complutense University campus area is a well-documented recurring site of large student 'macrobotellones' (mass open-air drinking gatherings), with one post-exam event leaving four municipal police officers injured and three people requiring treatment for alcohol poisoning. These are night-time phenomena tied to the student calendar; daytime campus activity shows no comparable pattern of disorder. Sources checked: El Independiente, Sept 2021; El Plural; Telemadrid, Apr 2022; ElDiario.es/Somos Madrid (EVAU botellon).

Is Ciudad Universitaria safe?

Wandroz currently rates Ciudad Universitaria in Madrid, Spain as relatively safer than most other areas covered on Wandroz during the day and roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz at night. This is a qualitative first-pass assessment based on general local knowledge and public reputation, not an official geolocated crime dataset — see the note on data limitations below before treating it as more precise than it is.

At night, Ciudad Universitaria is rated as roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.
